entities.summary: Sir Digvijaysinhji Ranjitsinhji Jadeja, known widely in Poland as the Good Maharaja, was the ruling Maharaja Jam Sahib of Nawanagar, succeeding his uncle, the famed cricketer Ranjitsinhji. He ruled Nawanagar from 1933 to 1947, when Nawanagar was merged into the United State of Kathiawar, after which he held his title nominally.
